blurb: Our Kelowna Mystery Wine Tour is a fun way to sign up for a day of wine touring in the region of OUR choice! Want to spend the day tasting wines but feeling overwhelmed with options? Leave the decision making up to us! In selecting our Kelowna Mystery Wine Tour, you will spend the day in one of the following wine regions: West Kelowna, Lake Country, East Kelowna, Naramata, or Oliver/Osoyoos. On this tour, you will experience an incredible day in Okanagan Wine Country, visiting award-winning wineries, enjoying beautiful views and sampling exceptional wines from 5 outstanding wineries. Feeling adventurous? This is the tour for you! Please note, the above itinerary is a sample only.
